einzeiler: Russell Brand discusses his upcoming UK trial, faith, and past addictions with Megyn…
kurzfassung: Megyn Kelly reevaluates her past views on Russell Brand in a wide-ranging interview ahead of his UK criminal trial. Brand speaks openly about his tumultuous childhood, severe drug addictions, and former promiscuity, framing his past through the lens of spiritual transformation. The conversation also touches on broader political themes, including government overreach during COVID-19 and shifting geopolitical alliances.
stichpunkte: Megyn Kelly admits her initial anger and subsequent reevaluation regarding sexual assault allegations against Russell Brand.
Russell Brand discusses the upcoming UK trial starting in October, addressing legal constraints and maintaining his innocence regarding non-consensual matters.
Brand details his journey from severe heroin and crack cocaine addiction to 12-step recovery and finding peace in Christianity.
The conversation explores Brand's book, How to Become a Christian in Seven Days, and the concept of rejecting false idols and worldly fame.
Brand and Kelly reflect on the parallels between their experiences as polarizing media figures targeted by institutional powers.
The dialogue touches on the psychological and spiritual dimensions of fame, comparing it to the emptiness of chemical addiction.
Brand analyzes the political landscape, discussing the centralization of power, pandemic-era controls, and skepticism toward mainstream narratives.
The discussion concludes with reflections on political disillusionment, the role of independent media, and the search for spiritual meaning.
beschreibung:
Megyn Kelly takes "A Second Look" at her two-hour interview with Russell Brand in April of 2026, as his trial begins this week in the UK.
